steps.instruction: Mix 2 cups of sugar, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of cornstarch in a pan.
steps.spoken: In a heavy-bottomed 3 to 4 quart pan, mix 2 cups of sugar, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of cornstarch until even.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 cup of honey and 3/4 cup of water.
Set the pan over medium-high heat and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Keep stirring until the mixture begins to boil.
Heat the mixture to 270 °F, without stirring.
Take the pan off the heat and pour the mixture onto a greased, lipped cookie sheet.
steps.spoken: Take the pan off the heat and pour the hot mixture onto a greased, lipped cookie sheet, a greased marble slab, or a silicone mat.

steps.instruction: Let the taffy cool until you can handle it with greased, clean hands.
Gather the taffy, then stretch, fold and recombine it for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Gather the taffy and stretch, fold and recombine it for 10 to 15 minutes without stopping, until it lightens in color and gets a satiny shine. It is easier with a friend.

steps.instruction: Roll the taffy into 1/2 inch ropes.
Cut the ropes into long pieces with a knife or greased scissors.
Wrap each piece in a small square of waxed paper and twist the ends.
